e.title: Stochastic Reserving (England)
e.summary: 随机准备金方法库（Peter England，13★，MIT）：解析闭式/Bootstrap/Bayesian MCMC——England & Verrall 2006 + IFRS 17/Solvency II 风险边际
e.summary_en: Stochastic reserving methods (Peter England, 13★, MIT): analytic closed-form/Bootstrap/Bayesian MCMC — England & Verrall 2006 + IFRS 17/Solvency II risk margins
e.summary_hk: 隨機準備金方法庫（Peter England，13★，MIT）：解析閉式/Bootstrap/Bayesian MCMC——England & Verrall 2006 + IFRS 17/Solvency II 風險邊際
e.body: StochasticReserving（Dr. Peter England，EMC Actuarial，13★，MIT）是教育性随机准备金代码库：R 与 Python 双语言复现 England & Verrall（2006）《Predictive distributions of outstanding liabilities》与 England、Verrall & Wüthrich（2019）《On the lifetime and one-year views of reserve risk》（IFRS 17/Solvency II 风险边际）——解析闭式/Bootstrap/Bayesian MCMC 三种方法。对 RIAA：随机准备金的标准方法库——英格兰-维拉尔方法是行业基准（[[reservingmodels]]、[[chainladder]] 配套）；终身 vs 一年期风险视角连接 IFRS 17 风险调整与 Solvency II 风险边际（[[ifrs17-calculation-engine-py]] 配套）；作者是随机准备金权威；适合准备金研究（[[rim540]] 相关）。
e.body_en: StochasticReserving (Dr. Peter England, EMC Actuarial, 13★, MIT) is an educational stochastic reserving codebase: R and Python reproductions of England & Verrall (2006) 'Predictive distributions of outstanding liabilities' and England, Verrall & Wüthrich (2019) 'On the lifetime and one-year views of reserve risk' (IFRS 17/Solvency II risk margins) — analytic closed-form/Bootstrap/Bayesian MCMC methods. For RIAA: the standard method library for stochastic reserving — the England-Verrall method is the industry benchmark (pairs with [[reservingmodels]] and [[chainladder]]); the lifetime-vs-one-year view connects IFRS 17 risk adjustment and Solvency II risk margins (pairs with [[ifrs17-calculation-engine-py]]); the author is an authority on stochastic reserving; suits reserving research ([[rim540]]-relevant).
e.body_hk: StochasticReserving（Dr. Peter England，EMC Actuarial，13★，MIT）是教育性隨機準備金代碼庫：R 與 Python 雙語言複現 England & Verrall（2006）《Predictive distributions of outstanding liabilities》與 England、Verrall & Wüthrich（2019）《On the lifetime and one-year views of reserve risk》（IFRS 17/Solvency II 風險邊際）——解析閉式/Bootstrap/Bayesian MCMC 三種方法。對 RIAA：隨機準備金的標準方法庫——英格蘭-維拉爾方法是行業基準（[[reservingmodels]]、[[chainladder]] 配套）；終身 vs 一年期風險視角連接 IFRS 17 風險調整與 Solvency II 風險邊際（[[ifrs17-calculation-engine-py]] 配套）；作者是隨機準備金權威；適合準備金研究（[[rim540]] 相關）。
e.verified_note: GitHub API 核实：MIT 许可，默认分支 main，README 确认复现 England & Verrall (2006) 与 England, Verrall & Wüthrich (2019)，R+Python 双语实现，含 Mack/ODP/负二项链梯与 MCMC
